questions.subject: english
questions.question: Walt Whitman is .......... years old in the poem.
questions.explanation: Kavita mein kavi Walt Whitman batate hain ki unki umra ab 37 saal hai ('I, now thirty-seven years old in perfect health begin').

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The poet in Song of Myself .......... for himself.
questions.explanation: Kavita ki shuruat mein hi kavi kehte hain: 'I celebrate myself, and sing myself'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I' in the first line of the poem 'Song of Myself' is the poet:
questions.explanation: Kavita ki pehli line mein 'I' shabd ka istemal kavi Walt Whitman ke liye kiya gaya hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Walt Whitman worked as a .......... before his twelfth birthday.
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ne 12 saal ki umra se pehle badhai (carpenter) ke roop mein kaam shuru kiya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'Leaves of Grass' is known for its free .......... and lack of rhyme.
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' apni mukt lay (free rhythms) aur bina rhyming ke format ke liye jani jati hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The Reflexive Pronoun of 'I' is ..........
questions.explanation: English grammar ke anusaar 'I' ka reflexive pronoun 'Myself' hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The line 'Hoping to cease not till death' is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh line Walt Whitman ki mashhoor rachna 'Song of Myself' se li gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The Reflexive Pronoun of 'They' is ..........
questions.explanation: 'They' ka sahi plural reflexive pronoun 'Themselves' hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: .......... Works include 'Leaves of Grass' and Drum Taps.
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' aur 'Drum Taps' Walt Whitman ki mukhya rachnayein hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Walt Whitman was a/an ..........
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman America ke kavi the, isliye unhe American poet kaha jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'And what I assume you shall assume' is taken from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh line kavita 'Song of Myself' ki suruati panktiyon mein se ek hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who remained relatively unappreciated in America during his lifetime?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ko apne jivan-kaal ke dauran America mein uchit sarahana nahi mili thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was Walt Whitman born?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ka janam 1819 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Nature without check with original ..........
questions.explanation: Kavita ki line hai: 'Nature without check with original energy'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: I observe a spear of .......... grass.
questions.explanation: Kavita mein kavi kehte hain: 'Observing a spear of summer grass'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year was the first edition of Leaves of Grass published?
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' ka pehla edition 1855 mein kavi ke niji kharche par chhapwaya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Leaves of grass is a collection of poems by ..........
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' Walt Whitman dwara likhi gayi kavitayon ka sangrah hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: 'I celebrate myself and sing myself' is the line from ..........
questions.explanation: Yeh prasiddh pankti 'Song of Myself' kavita ki sabse pehli line hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: During the civil war Walt Whitman also worked as a ..........
questions.explanation: American civil war ke samay unhone aspatalon mein volunteer nurse ke roop mein sewa ki thi.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Walt Whitman belongs to ..........
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman America desh se taalluk rakhte the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the theme of the poem?
questions.explanation: Is kavita ka mukhya vishay Universal brotherhood (sarvbhaumik bhaichara) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Walt Whitman is also called ..........
questions.explanation: Aam logon se jude hone ke kaaran Walt Whitman ko 'People's poet' kaha jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In how many sections the complete poem of song of myself has been divided?
questions.explanation: Poori 'Song of Myself' kavita kul 52 sections mein vibhajit hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Drum Taps was published in ..........
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ka sangrah 'Drum Taps' saal 1866 mein publish hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: He is considered one of the most .......... poets in American literature.
questions.explanation: Unhin American literature ke sabse prabhavshali (influential) kaviyon mein gina jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Leaves of Grass finally found a publisher willing to print .........
questions.explanation: 1881 mein bina kisi cut ya censorship ke (uncensored) ise chhapne wala publisher mila.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In which year did Walt Whitman pass away?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ka nidhan saal 1892 mein hua tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where is the resting place (cemetery) of Walt Whitman located?
questions.explanation: Unka samadhi sthal Harleigh Cemetery, Camden, New Jersey mein sthit hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What form of poetry is 'Song of Myself' written in?
questions.explanation: 'Song of Myself' bina kisi traditional chhand ya rhyming ke Free Verse format mein likhi gayi hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Approximately how many lines does the complete poem 'Song of Myself' contain?
questions.explanation: Mool kavita mein lagbhag 1300 panktiyan (lines) shaamil hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Why did Walt Whitman lose his job after publishing 'Leaves of Grass'?
questions.explanation: Unki kavitaon ki khuli bhasha ko us samay obscene (ashleel) maankar unhe naukri se nikal diya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which art historian wrote, 'You cannot really understand America without Walt Whitman'?
questions.explanation: Kala itihaskar Mary Berenson ne kaha tha ki Whitman aur unki kitabon ko samjhe bina America ko nahi samjha ja sakta.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to the poet, what are his tongue and blood formed from?
questions.explanation: Kavita mein kavi kehte hain ki unka khoon aur jeebh isi mitti aur isi hawa se bane hain ('Formed from this soil, this air').

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by 'Creeds and schools in abeyance'?

options.B: Religious sects and academic theories are temporarily set aside
options.C: He wants to join a new school

questions.explanation: 'In abeyance' ka matlab hai dharmik maton aur vicharon ko kuch samay ke liye ek taraf rakhna.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the word 'harbour' mean in the line 'I harbour for good or bad'?

options.C: To give shelter or accommodate in mind

questions.explanation: Yahan 'harbour' ka arth achhe aur bure dono vicharon ko man mein sthan dena hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by 'every hazard' in 'I permit to speak at every hazard'?
questions.explanation: 'At every hazard' ka matlab hai kisi bhi khatre ya mushkil paristithi ki parwah kiye bina bolna.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Where were the translations of 'Leaves of Grass' enthusiastically received?
questions.explanation: 'Leaves of Grass' ke anuwadon ka Europe mein kafi utsah ke sath swagat kiya gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What was the nature of Walt Whitman's funeral?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ka antim sanskar ek bada public event (sarvajanik samaroh) ban gaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which of the following professions was NOT practiced by Walt Whitman?
questions.explanation: Unhone badhai, patrakar, shikshak aur clerk ke roop mein kaam kiya, par pilot nahi the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In late December 1862, where did Whitman go to care for wounded soldiers?
questions.explanation: Late December 1862 mein we ghayal sainikon ki sewa ke liye Washington, D.C. gaye the.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the speaker celebrate and sing in the poem?
questions.explanation: Kavi kehte hain: 'I celebrate myself, and sing myself', jisme poori manavta ka jashn hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by saying 'every atom belonging to me as good belongs to you'?

options.A: Material goods must be equally divided
options.B: All humans share the same physical and spiritual existence
options.C: He is giving away his property
options.D: Humans are completely different from each other

questions.explanation: Iska arth hai ki sabhi insaan ek hi prakriti aur anuon se bane hain aur aapas mein jude hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet invite when he loafs at ease?
questions.explanation: Pankti hai: 'I loaf and invite my soul' yani we shanti se apni aatma ko aamantrit karte hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the word 'spear' symbolize in 'a spear of summer grass'?

options.B: A narrow leaf or blade of grass

questions.explanation: Yahan 'spear' ka matlab ghaas ki nukili patti ya tinke (blade of grass) se hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What generational continuity does the poet describe regarding his birth?

options.A: He was born from parents who came from abroad
options.B: He, his parents, and their parents were all born from the same soil
options.C: He does not know his ancestors
options.D: He was raised in an orphanage

questions.explanation: Kavi batate hain ki unke mata-pita aur unke purvaj sabhi isi mitti aur vatavaran mein janme hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the antonym of the word 'Hazard' used in the poem?
questions.explanation: 'Hazard' ka matlab khatra hota hai, iska vipritarthak (antonym) 'Safety' (suraksha) hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the line 'I loaf and invite my soul', what is the closest meaning of 'loaf'?
questions.explanation: 'Loaf' ka arth aaram se bina kisi jaldbaazi ke tehalna ya vishram karna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Which century does Walt Whitman primarily belong to as a major literary figure?
questions.explanation: Whitman ka jivan (1819–1892) mukhya roop se 19th century mein raha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by 'Nature without check'?

options.B: Nature in its pure, unrestricted and wild state

questions.explanation: 'Without check' ka arth prakriti ki aisi shakti se hai jis par koi manav-nirmit rok-tok na ho.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: According to the poet, what should never be forgotten while keeping creeds in abeyance?

options.A: That creeds must be permanently burned
options.B: Retiring back a while, yet never forgetting what they are
options.C: To create a completely new religion

questions.explanation: Kavi kehte hain: 'Retiring back a while sufficed at what they are, but never forgotten'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the synonym of the word 'Cease' as used in 'Hoping to cease not till death'?
questions.explanation: 'Cease' ka arth rukna ya samapt hona (to stop) hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What type of literary figure is Walt Whitman known as in American literature?
questions.explanation: Walt Whitman ko America ka sabse vyaktivadi (individualistic) lekhak aur kavi maana jata hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: In the poem, what state of health does the poet claim to begin with?
questions.explanation: Kavi kehte hain: 'I, now thirty-seven years old in perfect health begin'.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: How does the poet regard every other human being?

options.C: As equal and connected parts of humanity

questions.explanation: Whitman ke anusaar pratyek vyakti saman hai aur aapas mein jude huye hain.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: The collection 'Drum Taps' reflects Whitman's experiences during ..........
questions.explanation: 'Drum Taps' American Civil War ke dauran unke anubhavon par aadharit hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What grammatical form is the word 'myself' in the title?
questions.explanation: 'Myself' ek reflexive/emphatic pronoun hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the meaning of the word 'abeyance'?
questions.explanation: 'Abeyance' ka arth kisi cheez ko asthayi roop se sthagit ya vishram mein rakhna hota hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What does the poet mean by 'original energy' in the final line?

options.B: The pure and untamed primal force of nature

questions.explanation: 'Original energy' prakriti ki us shuddh aur aadi urja ko darshata hai jo niyam-mukt hai.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: Who printed the 1855 first edition of 'Leaves of Grass'?

options.A: A big publishing house in London
options.C: Walt Whitman himself at his own expense

questions.explanation: Koi publisher tayyar na hone ke kaaran Whitman ne ise swayam apne kharche par chhapwaya tha.

questions.subject: english
questions.question: What is the overall tone of Walt Whitman in 'Song of Myself'?
questions.explanation: Kavita ka swar anandmay, aatmavishwas se bhara aur loktantrik bhaavna (democratic) se yukta hai.
